title: a charter's answers_as outranks a stray instance-space dir of that name
intention: bin/cairn maps a typed word to the folder whose charter declares it as answers_as whenever no class folder carries that word, even when instance-space holds a directory of that name, so cairn database and cairn inference keep resolving after their shims have run (outline 11.3.2, 11.4.2).
why: Measured 2026-11-18: BaseShim._last_known_path (cairn/tools/base/shim.py:1152) writes instance_path(device_id), and the proxies' device_id is their answers_as name, so the first run creates ~/.cairn/devices/inference/0/last_known.json (on akiendelllinux) and ~/.cairn/devices/database/0/ (on akienlivingroom). bin/cairn:348 looks answers_as up only when neither a class folder NOR an instance dir carries the word, so from then on `cairn inference show` answers 'no such device or command: inference' (measured live on akiendelllinux, and over a scratch instance root: both aliases red, the folder name green).
traces_to: Outline 11.3.2 and 11.4.2 (the device names on the command line); Law 7 (the diagnostic surface names the real lack, and 'no such device' for a declared device is the wrong one).
how: bin/cairn: the answers_as block's condition drops `&& ! -d "$INSTANCE_ROOT/$device"`, so the lookup runs whenever the class folder is absent. A word no charter declares is unchanged (the loop rewrites nothing). The proof runs bin/cairn as a subprocess over a scratch CAIRN_INSTANCE_ROOT from the scratch door, holding stray inference/0/last_known.json and database/0/last_known.json, with a stub CAIRN_BUS_MOUTH that records its argv, shaped like bin/proofs/test_a_word_with_no_script_goes_onto_the_bus.py.

clauses.claim: with stray instance-space dirs named inference and database, `cairn inference show` and `cairn database show` reach the bus mouth with argv [<typed name>, show] and never print 'no such device'
a typed folder name (inferenceproxy) still resolves as itself and reaches the bus mouth with argv [inferenceproxy, show]
a word that no folder carries and no charter declares still reads 'no such device or command' and never reaches the bus mouth

decisions.text: D1: bin/cairn: the answers_as lookup runs whenever no class folder carries the typed word; the instance-dir test is dropped.
D2: the proof runs bin/cairn over a scratch instance root with stray dirs and a stub bus mouth, one tooth per clause, shaped like bin/proofs/test_a_word_with_no_script_goes_onto_the_bus.py.
